mapper.select: SELECT aa.*, s.student_name FROM attendance_applications aa LEFT JOIN students s ON aa.student_id = s.student_id WHERE aa.record_id = #{recordId}

SELECT aa.*, s.student_name FROM attendance_applications aa LEFT JOIN students s ON aa.student_id = s.student_id JOIN courses c ON aa.course_id = c.course_id WHERE c.teacher_id = #{teacherId} AND aa.status = 'pending' ORDER BY aa.create_time DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM attendance_applications aa JOIN courses c ON aa.course_id = c.course_id WHERE c.teacher_id = #{teacherId} AND aa.status = 'pending'
